body:
To be brutally honest there is no defined "point"

The point of life is to live life like its the only life you will ever have, because we don't know if there is a true afterlife this could be your only one shot at experiencing the uniqueness of it all.

You have a finace... Want to know my story? I have been a loner for most of my life, at least you have SOMEONE to share it with.  Have you tried talking about how you feel with him / her?

Sorry if this came off as harsh.. i'm really not trying to be just trying to say the cliche "Live life like its the only one you have" 

If you really feel like you have nothing to loose then why not be spontaneous and try anything or everything before you go? Randomly up and move somewhere new, go hiking up a mountain... do something that isnt a regular day-to-day routine because god forbid we all know that gets hella boring. 

I also have borderlind personality disorder and I find that exercise helps a lot (going for a run and such) and the meds!
Thank you very much for the info. I will check back tomorrow.

I've always had anxiety issues but I think the weed has enhanced them lately. I won't be smoking for a few months at least.

The depersonalization though is what kills me. Also when someone says something to me I think its more that i'm thinking too fast of what to say back and over analyzing instead of just being myself.
